text_block_list.text:
"That day... Rhein Kraft came to the Trainer's office
with an outrageous proposal."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
What do you think, Trainer...!?
I really, really want to try it!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Please!
No matter what, please...!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Please~...!

...When she gets like this, Rhein Kraft is stubborn.
In the end, I had to be the one to give in, and then—!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...To think I'd run into you in this race, Craft.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Cesario...!
Messiah-san too!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...It is, quite frankly, an unorthodox rotation that defies all understanding.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Going from the Oka Sho to the NHK Mile Cup, and then even running in the Oaks...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I'm surprised you gave permission for this too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Less 'forgiven' and more like
I just forcefully pushed my way through, but...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
—Still, I'm not taking this lightly.
I came here to win for real!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
What I want to do is forge a new path
for everyone who dreams of the Tiara route.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: To show them a back worth looking up to! In that case—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Running the NHK Mile Cup while also doing the entire Triple Tiara,"
that's an extraordinarily bold new challenge, right?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...Even if you came up with the idea,
would you actually go through with it? Honestly."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"What an absolute behemoth.
—However, I will never yield this ground."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Go ahead and take the lead with your high hopes and good spirits.
In the end, I will surely run you down...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Fufu. ...No, it's nothing!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Full of dreams, full of radiance!
I'm gonna win this, just watch me!
